summaries.en: Mitra-Regressor is an automated machine learning model designed to simplify tabular regression tasks, eliminating the need for manual feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning. It leverages ensemble techniques and automated pipeline construction to efficiently handle diverse datasets with minimal user intervention. Researchers and data scientists can deploy it via Hugging Face for quick prototyping or integrate it into workflows requiring reliable regression predictions on structured data.
summaries.zh: Mitra-Regressor 是一个专为表格数据回归任务设计的自动化机器学习模型，旨在简化预测建模流程，无需手动特征工程或超参数调整。它通过集成多种算法和自动构建处理流水线，能高效适应不同数据集的特点，降低使用门槛。用户可通过Hugging Face平台快速部署，适用于数据探索、原型开发或需要稳定回归预测的实际应用场景，为结构化数据分析提供便捷工具。
